$comment: PROPOSED schema — NOT APPLIED. Read APPWRITE-FUNCTIONS-DEPLOYMENT.md before creating anything. Verify against the live project first: if a 'sessions' collection already exists, STOP and reconcile rather than creating a duplicate.
purpose: Durable replacement for the OneBit server's process-local sessions Map (server/server.js:1561). Appwrite Functions run on independent short-lived instances, so sessions cannot live in process memory.

permissions.$comment: Least privilege: NO client role may read or write sessions. Only the Function's server API key touches this collection. Granting any 'users' or 'any' permission here would let a browser read session digests or mint sessions.

attributes.$comment: sha256 of the bearer token. The raw token is NEVER stored.
appwrite-auth | local-staff | local-tutor | free2027. Keeps the three existing identity systems separate.
The Founder-only guard compares this to 'Founder'.
Opaque JSON array; avoids requiring an array attribute.
Set on logout, password change or deactivation. Empty means live.

documentIdStrategy: sha256(token) truncated to 36 chars. Lookup is a direct getDocument; the FULL digest is still compared, so the truncated ID is only an index, not the credential.

migrationImpact.duplicatesExistingResource: UNKNOWN — must be verified against the live project before applying
migrationImpact.rollback: Leave the collection in place. It holds only sessions; deleting it would log everyone out of the Appwrite deployment but cannot affect OneBit sessions or any academic record.

verificationRequiredBeforeApply: Confirm no collection named 'sessions' already exists in goc_academy.
Confirm the project plan supports the attribute and index counts above.
Confirm datetime attributes are supported by the project's Appwrite version.
Confirm the Function's API key has databases.read and databases.write on this collection only.
